cands.name: Demi Busatta
cands.bio: Republican, Florida House since November 2020. Former nonprofit development director; chief of staff to Sen. Anitere Flores. Florida State University graduate. Unopposed in 2026.
cands.local_ties: Born in Cape Coral (1990); Miami-Dade legislator. Residence not stated in source.

record.text: Sponsored a 2021 bill addressing coastal flooding risk in oceanfront communities, sent to the governor in April 2021.

cands.gaps: Wikipedia is a stub; committees, donors, endorsements not found. Owner-source search NOT run (shared web-search budget exhausted).

votes.what: Joint resolution putting Amendment 3 (Save Our Homes property-tax changes: higher homestead exemption, lower assessment-increase limits) on the Nov 2026 ballot.
The 2025-26 General Appropriations Act (state budget), final vote.
Immigration enforcement bill from the 2025 special session: state cooperation with federal immigration enforcement.
Post-hurricane emergency management bill that also limits local governments' ability to adopt stricter development rules after storms.
